h: Personal Safeguards Carry the Torah Into Each Generation

p: "And Moshe spoke to the heads of the tribes
And our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Nedarim 78a):
to teach that the annulment of vows
it should not have written "the heads of the tribes"
And even if it came to mention all of them,
if the intent is only to experts,
a vow that is not for the sake of a mitzvah
בְּמַה שֶּׁמְּסַגֵּף עַצְמוֹ עַל לֹא דָבָר
for afflicting himself for no reason,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
"Is it not enough for you what the Torah forbade?"
Only the Sages and the Sanhedrin,
when they saw for the moment
גַּם מַה שֶּׁמּוּתָּר עַל פִּי תּוֹרָה
even what is permitted by the Torah.
וְהֵן הֵן גּוּפֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
And these are the very essentials of the Oral Torah,
וּכְמוֹ כֵן אֵיזֶה פְּרַט נֶפֶשׁ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
that extra guarding of his soul is needed,
to sanctify himself in what is permitted to him
"And Moshe spoke to the heads of the tribes":
that is, the Sanhedrin and the eyes of the congregation,
to add to the words of Torah,
to make what is permitted an actual prohibition
for the need of the time.
it was given to the Children of Yisrael,
when one senses in his soul
וְעַל זֶה גָּמַר אוֹמֵר (בְּמִדְבַּר ל, ג)
"A man who vows a vow to Hashem
to bind a prohibition upon his soul"
that it has the force of an actual prohibition,
and therefore "he shall not profane his word."
to the heads of the tribes,
for this does not pertain to him,
for he is the root of
And our Sages, of blessed memory, said (in the Sifrei, Matos 1)
in that he prophesied with "this is the thing."
That is, with all the prophets,
rather it has a likeness and a connection
to the nature of the recipient;
and therefore the prophet has the power
to say the words according to his nature,
that Yoshiyah sent to Chuldah for this reason:
in that he prophesied with "this is the thing":
exactly as it is in essence.
And one may say that this is the matter of
מַאֲמָרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כא, ב)
their saying, of blessed memory (Rosh Hashanah 21b),
עַל לֹא קָם נָבִיא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמֹשֶׁה (דְּבָרִים לד, י)
on "There arose no other prophet in Yisrael like Moshe" (Devarim 34:10):
but among the nations of the world one arose,
that is, in this respect, one opposite the other.
that came out of his mouth.
that he would be able to change the wording
for he wanted to prophesy in the aspect of "koh,"
put a bridle in his mouth
"Return to Balak and thus shall you speak";
שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה לוֹ שׁוּם רְשׁוּת וָכֹחַ
so that he had no permission or power
only the movement of his lips alone;

p: Now, the expression "this is the thing"
נֶאֱמַר גַּם בִּבְנוֹת צְלָפְחָד (בְּמִדְבַּר לו, ו)
is also said regarding the daughters of Tzelafchad (Bamidbar 36:6)
and regarding the jar of the mann (Shemos 16:32).
And one may say about this
שֶׁאֵינָם שַׁיָּיכִים לְמֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
that do not pertain to Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
spoke this from within his mouth.
For all the words of the Torah
in all the souls of Yisrael
it indicates what we said above,
that the essence of this power
is only specifically for the need of the moment,
which senses in itself the need for it.
And regarding the daughters of Tzelafchad,
"this is the thing" is said explicitly,
שֶׁהַדִּין לֹא תִסּוֹב נַחֲלָה (בְּמִדְבַּר לו, ז)
for the law "an inheritance shall not pass" (Bamidbar 36:7)
And so too regarding the jar of the mann,
which He commanded to set aside for safekeeping
from the side of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him.
to enter the Land for certain,
had the sin not caused otherwise;
that existed then, before the sin of the Golden Calf,
there would have been no need for safekeeping
would have been clear in their hearts
And so all their eating would forever have been
like the eating of the mann,
and they would not have been troubled
and by their faith they would live,
that "by whatever comes forth from the mouth of Hashem
"And strangers shall stand and tend your flocks, etc."
And about this it is said with the expression
"this is the thing that Hashem commanded,"
only for the need of a future time;
for it was revealed before Him, Yisbarach,
and there would be a lack of faith in the world,
the jar of the mann would be needed,
who brought out the jar of the mann for them
"O generation, see the word of Hashem."

p: וְהִנֵּה יֵשׁ לְהָבִין בָּזֶה גַּם כֵּן
Now, with this we can also understand
the juxtaposition of the passage that follows (Bamidbar 31:2):
"Take vengeance for the Children of Yisrael
afterward you will be gathered to your people."
that they were in the wilderness,
the root of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
the aspect of the Written Torah;
and had they entered the Land
with Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
there would then have been the ultimate refinement in completeness,
and there would never have been any exile.
However, at the end of the forty years,
the venom of the kelipah was introduced
until, Heaven forbid, there would have been corrupted
the entire root of the holiness of Yisrael, Heaven forbid.
וְאִלְמָלֵא עֲצַת מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And were it not for the counsel of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
which was in the vengeance against Midyan,
וְכָל אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת אִישׁ וְגוֹ׳ (בְּמִדְבַּר לא, יז)
"and every woman who has known a man, etc." (Bamidbar 31:17)
there would have been, Heaven forbid,
a strengthening of the kelipah of the evil inclination,
to the point that it could not be subdued,
רַק דַּיְיקָא עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
only specifically through Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
who is the aspect of Daas in holiness
he is the one who opposes and nullifies
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Sotah 3a):
"A person does not commit a sin
unless there has entered into him
And the essence of the spirit of folly
is in the kelipah of lust,
which was in the worship of Pe'or,
of which even the gentile woman said:
And this is the evil inclination of lust,
which is called in the words of Chazal
חֵמֶת מָלֵא צוֹאָה וְכוּלֵּי (שַׁבָּת קנב, א)
something of the aspect of the Daas
of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
this matter is despicable and loathsome in his eyes:
he would lose himself from both worlds.
הָיְתָה קְבוּרַת מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
the burial of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
in order to subdue this kelipah
And for this it was said to him in this parsha:
"Take vengeance for the Children of Yisrael
afterward you will be gathered to your people."
he would weaken the power of the kelipah of the evil inclination,
and there would be power for those entering the Land,
that is, the generation after him,
to make for themselves fences and safeguards

p: "The burnt-offering of each Shabbos on its Shabbos";
for every parsha that is read each Shabbos
to the Shabbos on which it falls;
and so it says in the Prophets,
And certainly this parsha has a connection
to the fact that it is always read
כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּתֵּן כָּל פְּרַט נֶפֶשׁ עַל לִבּוֹ
so that each individual soul take to heart
is as if it was destroyed in his days."
That is, every individual Jewish soul
in the measure of his days,
meaning to repair in his soul
which holds back the building of the Beis HaMikdash;
"Is the iniquity of Pe'or too little for us,
from which we have not cleansed ourselves
that throughout all the days of this world
when the rectification will be complete.
no proof is brought from here
that it is not in effect forever,
to make fences and safeguards for himself
as is said in this parsha.
And this too is one matter
with what is said regarding the gid hanasheh (Bereishis 32:33):
וְכַנִּזְכָּר בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קע, ב)
and as is mentioned in the holy Zohar (I 170b),
there are three hundred sixty-five sinews in a person,
corresponding to the number of days of the solar year;
for the evil inclination wrestled with man,
וַיַּרְא כִּי לֹא יָכוֹל לוֹ (בְּרֵאשִׁית לב, כו)
"and he saw that he could not prevail against him" (Bereishis 32:26),
"and he touched the hollow of his thigh,"
for there he has a hold;
and it corresponds to Tishah B'Av,
עַל כֵּן לֹא יֹאכְלוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
"therefore the Children of Yisrael do not eat
so as not to give him a hold
all the days of this world,
when the Beis HaMikdash will be rebuilt,
and the fast of the fifth month will be turned
Amen, may it be His will.

paragraphs.text: Source: Zechariah 8:19 — “כה אמר יהוה צבאות צום הרביעי וצום החמישי וצום השביעי וצום העשירי יהיה לבית יהודה לששון ולשמחה ולמעדים טובים והאמת והשלום אהבו” — “Thus said GOD of Hosts: The fast of the fourth month, the fast of the fifth month,ffast of the fifth month Commemorating the events of 2 Kings …”

rich.text: “כה אמר יהוה צבאות צום הרביעי וצום החמישי וצום השביעי וצום העשירי יהיה לבית יהודה לששון ולשמחה ולמעדים טובים והאמת והשלום אהבו”
— “Thus said GOD of Hosts: The fast of the fourth month, the fast of the fifth month,ffast of the fifth month Commemorating the events of 2 Kings …”
